title: Soul Coin
summary: Karlach can consume this coin to fuel Infernal Fury until Long Rest.

fields.Infernal Fury: Karlach consumes one coin. Until Long Rest, weapon attacks add 1d4 Fire while Raging and a separate 1d4 Fire below 25% HP. Unarmed strikes are reported to add 2d4 Fire without either trigger. Does not apply in Wild Shape.
fields.Inspiration: First collection grants Soul for Sale to Noble party members.
fields.Acquisition: 19 documented coins across the three acts. Lann Tarv can give three to Karlach if she listens to their stories.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
